summary: MSP Recovery filed an 8-K reporting entry into a series of small letter agreements with Hazel Partners Holdings LLC, as administrative agent and lender under its existing working capital credit facility, providing incremental fundings of $0.06M (Sept 2), $0.35M (Sept 7), $0.03M (Sept 10), $0.11M (Sept 18), and additional amounts on or after Sept 24, 2026, each funded on or shortly after signing. The filing also covers a direct financial obligation and a compensatory arrangement/officer departure item under Item 5.02. No shareholder, board recommendation, advisor, price per share, or premium is disclosed. These are routine credit draws and governance updates, not a special situation; monitor liquidity, dilution risk from the warrant overhang, and any further officer changes.
